scope: Route trailing DXF XDATA after embedded MTEXT to the containing ATTRIB or ATTDEF, with generated ASCII/Binary controls.

change.invariant: XDATA group codes 1000-1071 after an embedded ATTRIB/ATTDEF MTEXT object are owned by the host record, not the nested MTEXT object.
change.behavior: DRW_Attrib::parseCode dispatches XDATA to DRW_Entity::parseCode whenever an embedded MTEXT exists. This handles both marker 100 and canonical marker 101 even though marker 101 exits the host subclass-state flag.
coverage: Generated ASCII and Binary DXF input with a registered HOST_APP APPID.
Four ATTRIB child records and four ATTDEF records with distinct 1000 and 1070 XDATA values.
Exact host XDATA order and empty nested-MTEXT extData assertions.
Copy, assignment, reset, canonical writer output, same-library readback, and following LINE sentinel.
Existing fallback text, tags, prompt, background fields and orientation assertions remain active.

remainingInScope: Pre-R2018 linked-column XDATA semantics and caller-created nested-MTEXT XDATA policy.
